title: fix(scripts): check-issue-citations re-execs through the proxy instead of prescribing it
body:
Fixes #18949

## What was wrong

`scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` imported `proxyRearmPlan` and used it only to
compose a hint string. In a container whose only route out is `HTTPS_PROXY` — which
node's `fetch` does not read — every board read answered HTTP 401, so a live run
refused with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3) while holding, and printing, the plan
that would have completed the read. Loud and correct, one re-exec short of an answer.

## What changed (one file: `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`)

`rearmThroughProxy()` now EXECUTES that plan, on the shape
`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` and `scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` have run daily:
re-exec this file under `--use-env-proxy`, adopt the child's exit code, degrade
loudly when the re-exec cannot happen. All three arms are kept and each is an answer:

| arm | behaviour |
|---|---|
| `plan.hint` | print why the route cannot be re-armed, carry on, refuse below if the read fails |
| `plan.rearm` | re-exec with the flag and adopt the child's exit code |
| re-exec failed | continue in-process **and say** every request will bypass the proxy |

The guard is **this gate's own** variable, `OS_ISSUE_CITATIONS_PROXY_REARMED` — never
a shared or inherited name. A sibling instrument's guard answering "already re-armed"
here is silent, and turns a route failure into a false story about the credential.

The re-exec is taken by the live modes only: `--self-test` is offline (and pinned
offline) and `--list` makes no request, so neither spawns a child to prove a route
nothing is about to use.

## Evidence (this container)

**Before** — `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --census`, `exit=3`:

```text
❌ check-issue-citations: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the board was not read.
   GET https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&per_page=100&sort=created&direction=asc -> HTTP 401 (HTTPS_PROXY is set (http://127.0.0.1:36723) and node's fetch does not read it — re-run with `node --use-env-proxy …` or NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1)
   ⛔ Nothing below is a reading. …
```

**After** — same command, `exit=0`, the board is actually read:

```text
ℹ️  re-exec with --use-env-proxy: HTTPS_PROXY is set (http://127.0.0.1:36723) and node's fetch does not read it.
board: enumerated (175 pages), frontier #19252, 17411 numbers resolve
citations judged: 34710 across 2405 file(s)
   29805  resolves
    2167  allocated-but-absent
    1460  resolves-as-pull-request
    1278  cross-repo-unjudged
…
ℹ️  census: 2167 unresolvable citation site(s). Report-only — this mode never fails.
```

## "Cannot read" was NOT converted into "silently passes"

Three genuinely unreadable runs, each still `exit=3` with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`:

```text
A  OS_ISSUE_CITATIONS_PROXY_REARMED=1 (the guard already spent)  -> exit 3
   ℹ️  … the one re-exec this run allows was already spent … unsetting
       OS_ISSUE_CITATIONS_PROXY_REARMED is the fix rather than a new token
   ❌ check-issue-citations: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the board was not read.

B  HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:1 (re-exec happens, the child cannot reach out) -> exit 3
   ℹ️  re-exec with --use-env-proxy: …
   ❌ check-issue-citations: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the board was not read.
      fetch failed

C  no proxy, no token at all -> exit 3
   ❌ check-issue-citations: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the board was not read.
      GET …/issues?state=all… -> HTTP 403
```

⚠️ Note for whoever repeats this: a bare "no token" run is NOT unreadable in an agent
container — this box's proxy carries the credential, so `--census` with
`GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` unset still reads the board and exits 0. The three cases
above are constructed so the read genuinely cannot happen.

**The third arm, proven by ablation** (mutation confirmed on disk — anchor gone,
marker present — then restored, `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash back to
`e7a3516c5`): with `process.execPath` replaced by a path that does not exist,

```text
ℹ️  re-exec with --use-env-proxy: …
⚠️  could not re-exec with --use-env-proxy (spawnSync /nonexistent/node-ABLATION ENOENT); continuing in-process — every request will bypass the proxy.
❌ check-issue-citations: PREREQUISITE NOT MET — the board was not read.   exit 3
```

## Tests

A new `proxy-rearm` self-test battery (10 cases, floor pinned) covers the guard name
against the patrol's, all three arms, the Actions-runner leg (no proxy ⇒ no re-exec,
not one extra line), and structurally: the plan is imported rather than restated, the
dispatch really hands it THIS file's guard, and the re-exec sits in the live-mode arm
only. `--self-test` stays offline.

```text
✅ check-issue-citations --self-test: … (66 cases, 7 batteries)    # was 56 cases, 6 batteries
```

All 26 commands from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
(derived against this branch's own change set) exit 0, plus `pnpm check:issue-citations`.
`npx eslint scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --no-inline-config` exits 0.

## Declared gaps — ⛔ not fixed here, and not claimed to be

- **CI wiring is untouched.** No workflow invokes this gate; that is #18224's lane and
  it is not addressed here. A local re-exec changes nothing in CI, and the CI wiring
  changes nothing locally.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`
  (`proxyRearmPlan` itself) and `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` are untouched — other surfaces.
- No changeset: this file ships in no package's `files[]` and the root manifest is
  `private: true`, so nothing released moves. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, which
  `.github/workflows/lint.yml` names as the textbook case for a CI-internal script.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: the census now reads 2,167 `allocated-but-absent` sites against a
  frontier of #19252 (the card's own 2026-09-14 reading was 2,785 against #18219) — a
  standing, report-only debt this gate declares by design, not a finding. Owner of a
  follow-up: none identified.
- noted, not filed: `OS_<TOOL>_PROXY_REARMED` is now spelled out by hand in six
  instruments (`post-stamped`, `board-snapshot`, `check-expected-skips`,
  `check-clause2-carriers`, `check-governed-merges`, and this gate); each correctly
  owns its name, so there is no defect, only a convention nothing enumerates.
